description: This file defines classes related to device inventory information in the wfa_map namespace, including tlvDeviceInventory and cRadioVendorInfo, with methods for managing device and radio vendor data.

classes.name: tlvDeviceInventory
classes.description: Represents a device inventory with serial number, software version, execution environment, and radios vendor info.

classes.name: cRadioVendorInfo
classes.description: Contains radio vendor information including RUID and chipset vendor details.

methods.name: tlvDeviceInventory
methods.description: Constructs a tlvDeviceInventory object from buffer or shared pointer.

methods.name: ~tlvDeviceInventory
methods.description: Destructor for tlvDeviceInventory.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the TLV.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the TLV.

methods.name: serial_number_length
methods.description: Gets the length of the serial number.

methods.name: serial_number_str
methods.description: Returns the serial number as a string.

methods.name: set_serial_number
methods.description: Sets the serial number from string or buffer.

methods.name: alloc_serial_number
methods.description: Allocates memory for serial number.

methods.name: software_version_length
methods.description: Gets the length of the software version.

methods.name: software_version_str
methods.description: Returns the software version as a string.

methods.name: set_software_version
methods.description: Sets the software version from string or buffer.

methods.name: alloc_software_version
methods.description: Allocates memory for software version.

methods.name: execution_environment_length
methods.description: Gets the length of the execution environment string.

methods.name: execution_environment_str
methods.description: Returns the execution environment as a string.

methods.name: set_execution_environment
methods.description: Sets the execution environment from string or buffer.

methods.name: alloc_execution_environment
methods.description: Allocates memory for execution environment.

methods.name: number_of_radios
methods.description: Returns the number of radios.

methods.name: radios_vendor_info
methods.description: Accesses radio vendor info at a given index.

methods.name: create_radios_vendor_info
methods.description: Creates a new radio vendor info object.

methods.name: add_radios_vendor_info
methods.description: Adds a radio vendor info object to the list.

methods.name: class_swap
methods.description: Swaps class data for endianness or serialization.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the object for serialization.

methods.name: get_initial_size
methods.description: Returns initial size for object allocation.
